title: Course Validity Days When a Visit Referral Is Lengthened
content:
A lengthening of an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) adds the type's extension validity days to the valid-through date.

## Calculation

- The **course validity days** are the type's extension validity days, the per-type figure of the Referrals & Prior Authorizations schedule.
- The course validity days are counted in **calendar days**, as a whole number.
- The **new valid-through date** is the current valid-through date moved forward by the course validity days.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Current valid-through date | 2026-06-30 |
| Extension validity days of the type (hypothetical) | 60 |
| Course validity days | 60 |
| New valid-through date | 2026-08-29 |

From 30 June, 31 calendar days reach 31 July and a further 29 reach 29 August.
